support.topics.items.anxiety.description: Anxiety can affect your thoughts, body, sleep and everyday decisions.

support.topics.items.depression.descript: When the details of everyday life begin to feel heavier than they used to
support.topics.items.depression.details: Depression is not limited to feeling sad. It can affect the way you think, feel, relate to others, and manage your daily life. It may show up as a sense of inner emptiness, persistent exhaustion, loss of interest or motivation, recurring irritability, or emotional numbness, even when everything appears normal from the outside. You do not have to face this alone. Begin your journey toward understanding and recovery through a therapeutic session in a safe and supportive environment.

support.topics.items.depression.title: Depression

support.topics.items.self-esteem.descrip: Low self-esteem may appear through self-criticism, comparison, doubt or difficulty recognising your own value.
